cases.assertion: Fake acceptance and Sent copy have separate statuses, neither proves delivery.
Nonfixture, non-.invalid recipient and sender are rejected without fallback.
Required proposal/decision/start audit failure blocks before fake submission.
Wrong folder, absent/stale IDs and fabricated references produce errors with no guessed target.
Result limits, ASCII query encoding and required tool fields are enforced.
Only safe reads retry, within fixed three-attempt upper bound and simulated delay.
Canceling an already approved proposal revokes its unused approval.
Deterministic scorer rejects an unsupported delivered claim and accepts only the observed synthetic status.
Failed Sent copy preserves acceptance and never repairs itself by resending.
Approval cannot be swapped between proposals; exact-action dedup correlates requested and original receipt IDs.
Denial is terminal; later approval or alternate send execution does not reopen it.
Draft is stored separately and cannot authorize/send an action.
Local test-owner capability approves exact digest once, with fixture/run/time/actor bindings.
Exactly-at-expiry is rejected and requires a new proposal/decision.
Missing workflow metadata and malformed context/fixture types reject before backend creation.
Absent/forged approver, model boolean/source and foreign capability cannot grant approval.
Approval cannot be used before its creation time.
Unauthorized sender alias and CRLF in sender, target or subject are rejected.
Reusing a key for a different action rejects; changed repeated payload rejects before cache lookup.
Reentrant execution of a new exact-action proposal is blocked by the pre-transport reservation.
Changed context, policy, fixture version or original message version invalidates approval.
Changed fixture Reply-To without version bump invalidates approval, even if reverted later.
Mail-body claims of management approval produce no permission or write.
Malformed sender, recipient, CC, folder and tool types fail with typed errors and minimized rejection events.
Changing exact approved body invalidates action and causes zero transport calls.
Changing exact approved cc invalidates action and causes zero transport calls.
Changing exact approved context_digest invalidates action and causes zero transport calls.
Changing exact approved fixture_digest invalidates action and causes zero transport calls.
Changing exact approved fixture_version invalidates action and causes zero transport calls.
Changing exact approved operation invalidates action and causes zero transport calls.
Changing exact approved original_folder invalidates action and causes zero transport calls.
Changing exact approved original_message_digest invalidates action and causes zero transport calls.
Changing exact approved original_message_id invalidates action and causes zero transport calls.
Changing exact approved original_message_version invalidates action and causes zero transport calls.
Changing exact approved sender invalidates action and causes zero transport calls.
Changing exact approved subject invalidates action and causes zero transport calls.
Changing exact approved to invalidates action and causes zero transport calls.
Changing exact approved tool_name invalidates action and causes zero transport calls.
Socket, SMTP, IMAP, DNS, HTTP and subprocess network routes are denied before transport.
Full synthetic flow never constructs SMTP, IMAP, socket or HTTP clients, even disconnected ones.
Partial acceptance records accepted/rejected recipients separately and never automatically resends.
Pending proposal and direct backend invocation cannot submit.
Unknown/out-of-profile tools and approval/execution calls through tools are denied.
Failed post-submission trace retains terminal acceptance; no automatic/new-key resend.
Mutating returned preview/CC cannot mutate stored action; forged preview digest is rejected.
List/search/read return exact fixtures and never mutate the read flag.
Explicit pre-submission fake rejection is failed, never delivered, attempted once.
Repeated approve/execute returns one receipt; a fresh key cannot resend consumed permission.
Reply-To is the preview and transport destination; no reply-all or From fallback.
Unknown mode, missing/invalid fixtures fail before any fake backend creation.
Trace schema is complete and omits body/subject, canary credentials and raw exception data.
Unknown submission is terminal and remains uncertain on replay or a newly approved exact-action proposal.
Unexpected adapter exception after invocation returns sanitized uncertainty, never a retryable success/failure.
